source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT LastLoadDate FROM raw.Watermark WHERE TableName = 'Customers'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(LastModifiedDate), CAST('2000-01-01' AS DATETIME2(0))) AS NewWatermark FROM raw.Customers

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT CustomerID, CustomerName, City, LastModifiedDate FROM raw.Customers WHERE LastModifiedDate > ''', formatDateTime(activity('Lookup_Old_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastLoadDate, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'), ''' AND LastModifiedDate <= ''', formatDateTime(activity('Lookup_New_Watermark').output.firstRow.NewWatermark, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss'), '''')
